name: DeFi Plaza (DefiPlaza V2 DEX, Ethereum)
verdict_reason: The real attacker is EOA 0x14b362d2... (attack contract 0xa4e8969b..., deployed in tx 0x8f029510... at 13:15:29.185 UTC first-seen together with its run() tx 0xe00b0998...). Yoink's tx 0xa245deda... sits at position 0 of block 20240539 and drains the same pool with 25 DeFi Plaza state-changing calls whose calldata and ETH values are byte-identical to what the attacker's own contract issues when its deploy+run() are replayed on a local fork of block 20240538; the attacker's deploy landed at position 3 of the same block, but its run() tx never made it into block 20240539 and landed one block later (20240540, position 27) reverting on an empty pool. Ordering evidence: attacker txs seen in the public mempool 5.8 s before the slot and 3.0 s before Yoink's builder's first bid; Yoink's own tx never appears in the public mempool.
era: post-Merge, mempool-dumpster sourcelog + Flashbots relay bids available (other relays: delivered-payload only)

possible_second_eoa.evidence: tx 0xbb5dffb0... deployed byte-identical initcode (26,794 hex chars, same 0x5f805460 wrapper selector) with nonce 0, first seen 1,201 ms BEFORE the attacker's own deploy; funded 0.1 ETH at 13:08:11 (tx 0x795f04e8345e...); only ever deployed (contract 0xd2a63475e4207f286f45586ae8d2200f4e64e41b never called). Relationship to 0x14b362d2 is unproven (label: inferred, same tooling).

replay_evidence.method: local anvil fork at block 20240538; attacker's deploy tx input + run() tx input replayed from the attacker EOA (impersonated); DeFi Plaza ('0xe68c1d72...') calls extracted with callTracer from both runs
replay_evidence.diff: after dropping one STATICCALL balanceOf(0x70a08231) that only the attacker's contract makes, the two call lists match 25/25: same selectors (23 x 0xfe029156, 1 x 0xce359797 with 32,732.54 ETH, 1 x 0xc4ccdeea), same calldata bytes, same ETH values; only msg.sender differs (attacker contract 0xa4e8969b -> Yoink bot 0x6980a47b). Funding differs: Yoink wraps it in a Balancer flashLoan (9 tokens) and an Aave V3 flashLoan; sweeps proceeds to its vault.
replay_evidence.yoink_script_decode: research/bot-re/incident_txs.json['defiplaza']: 19 approvals, Balancer flashLoan, 12 swap ops, unwrap, 6 sweeps; bribe rule msg.value>=1000 -> fixed v*1e11 wei (analysis.md section 3 and 4.3)

bots.notes: No Yoink tx hash is in the public mempool (0 rows in dumpster csv + sourcelog): the bot reacted to the attacker's pending txs, built its block through its own builder, and was delivered via Flashbots + Ultra Sound relays.

headline_text: Yoink drained DeFi Plaza (~$217K) at block 20240539 position 0, replaying the attacker's pending deploy+run() pair; the attacker's run() reverted a block later. Yoink bribed 66.3 ETH; only ~$23K of tokens came back, no ETH.

harmonized.verdict_reason: Yoink idx 0 of 20240539 replays the attacker's 25 DeFi Plaza calls byte for byte while the attacker's still-pending run() landed in 20240540 and reverted.
